anomalies.description: A man in a black shirt is engaged in close physical combat with another person; his head is forced downward and his face is pressed against the opponent's body/shoulder in a grappling or clinch motion.
Two men engage in a close-quarters physical struggle; one man is seen delivering or receiving a blow, with visible motion blur and body tension indicating active combat.

A person's hand rests on a table near a hammer and other objects while another individual lies motionless on the floor (partially visible in f10–f15), suggesting a post-assault scenario where the victim is incapacitated and the perpetrator is present.

A shirtless man is restrained with his arms raised and bound above his head, appearing helpless while being observed by two other individuals in a dimly lit room; this constitutes physical restraint of a vulnerable person consistent with abuse.
A man stands in front of a shirtless person who is restrained with hands bound above head, suggesting a captive or helpless victim; the setting and posture indicate imminent or ongoing abuse.

A hand selects a serrated surgical-style blade from a case of instruments, implying preparation for violent or torturous action against the restrained individual.; A woman enters the scene and observes the restrained victim and the armed perpetrator; her presence does not interrupt the abusive situation, which remains active and threatening.
A multi-person physical fight occurs in a dimly lit room; several individuals are on the ground while others engage in close combat, with visible grappling and striking motions.
A person is seen lying on the ground while another individual (with long hair) appears to be restraining or assaulting them; the victim shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness.
A shirtless man is actively engaged in combat, raising his arms to strike or block, while others are on the floor; motion blur indicates dynamic struggle.

A shirtless man is shown with arms raised above head in a strained posture, possibly restrained or being forced into submission by an off-screen aggressor; his facial expression suggests distress and lack of control.

A shirtless man engages in intense hand-to-hand combat with multiple opponents in a dimly lit industrial basement. He performs acrobatic maneuvers including a vertical pole swing (f0–f4), a mid-air flip and strike (f5–f7), lands and continues fighting (f8–f10), executes a takedown (f11), and ends with opponents subdued on the floor while he recovers (f12–f15).
One individual is restrained and appears helpless while another uses a knife near their leg/ankle area in a threatening manner, consistent with abuse of a subdued victim.
A prolonged physical fight involving multiple participants in a dimly lit room; includes close-up struggles, weapon use (knife), grappling, throws, and ground fighting.
A prolonged physical fight between two individuals: one in black (female) and one shirtless (male), involving grappling, throws, and ground combat in a dim industrial setting.
A moment where the female appears subdued on the ground while the male is positioned over her in a controlling manner, suggesting non-consensual dominance during the fight sequence.
A shirtless man and a woman engage in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat; the man blocks/deflects an attack, then lifts and throws the woman.
A person lies motionless on the floor while another figure looms over them; the context of ongoing fight suggests the prone individual is helpless and possibly being struck or subdued.

A shirtless man and a woman are engaged in close physical confrontation; the man turns away while the woman appears to react defensively or aggressively, with bodies in proximity and dynamic motion suggesting active combat.

A bald man lies on the floor, initially supine (f9), then pushes himself up into a push-up position (f10–f15) while another person (shirtless man) walks away in the background; the prone position and context suggest he was incapacitated by prior violence, and his struggle to rise indicates he is a helpless victim being left after an attack.
